name: University of Canterbury
description: The University of Canterbury is a public research university in Christchurch, established in 1873 as Canterbury College. It has about 20,800 students across six faculties including engineering, science and business.
whyIncluded: UC offers articulation pathways for engineering diploma holders from Singapore's five polytechnics into its Bachelor of Engineering (Hons), and New Zealand is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 360 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.summary: The university's own estimate for one student sharing a flat, over 12 months: rent, power, internet, food, transport, phone and insurance. Excludes bond, furnishings, books, parking and clothing.
livingCosts.notes: UC 'Flatting - estimate of costs' (page dated 15 July 2026; single person sharing a 4-bedroom house in Ilam), weekly x 52/12. Housing: rent $200 + power $20 + internet $8/wk. Food: $145/wk. Transport: $25/wk. Personal: mobile phone $8 + contents and liability insurance $10 + other/incidentals $20/wk. UC's weekly total is $436. Excludes one-off and annual extras (bond $800, rent in advance $400, furnishings $750, books $750, parking $560, clothing $750). UC's halls estimate is $525/wk.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Data Science
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students for the 2027 intake; the actual fee depends on courses chosen and rises yearly. Student services levy included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2027 international tuition fee estimate per 120 points (BDataSc, 360 points = 3 years); actual fee depends on courses. UC also publishes 2028: $46,125. Compulsory = Student Services Levy for on-campus study, $10.30/point x 120 = $1,236 in 2026 (2027 rate not yet published). Excludes insurance. No 2024/2025 history: the BDataSc estimate blends Science and Business fee bands and UC no longer publishes earlier years' per-qualification estimates; the UC Calendar fee bands give no single BDataSc figure. Rows from Wayback captures of UC's International tuition fees page (https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/getting-started/study-and-living-costs/study-costs/international-tuition-fees), which then listed per-qualification estimates: capture 20240806165814 lists 2024 and 2025 estimates, capture 20250401065822 repeats them unchanged and adds 2026 ('Bachelor of Data Science (BDataSc) - 360 points 2024 tuition fee estimate: $38,981 per 120 points 2025 tuition fee estimate: $40,500 per 120 points 2026 tuition fee estimate: $42,080 per 120 points'; the 2026 figure matches the existing 2026 row). Compulsory = Student Services Levy $9.17/point x 120 = $1,100.40 for both 2024 and 2025 (UC Calendar 2024/2025 Fees and Fines Regulations, as used for UC's other 2024/2025 rows). Corrects the earlier note that no earlier per-qualification estimates are available.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering with Honours
programmes.summary: Year 1 costs about NZ$49,540 in 2027; years 2 to 4 cost about NZ$54,180 a year at 2027 rates (rising to about NZ$56,890 in 2028). Student services levy included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2027 international tuition fee estimate per 120 points for the FIRST year of the BE(Hons) (480 points = 4 years); UC quotes second to fourth years higher at $54,180 (2026: $51,900; 2028: $56,890), which this single annual figure does not capture. Compulsory = 2026 Student Services Levy $10.30/point x 120 = $1,236 (2027 not yet published). Excludes insurance. No 2024/2025 history: the first-year BE(Hons) estimate blends fee bands (the Calendar's Engineering band, $48,000 in 2024 and $49,900 in 2025, is the second-to-fourth-year rate) and UC no longer publishes earlier years' per-qualification estimates. Rows from Wayback captures of UC's International tuition fees page (https://www.canterbury.ac.nz/study/getting-started/study-and-living-costs/study-costs/international-tuition-fees), which then listed per-qualification estimates: capture 20240806165814 lists 2024 and 2025 estimates, capture 20250401065822 repeats them unchanged and adds 2026 ('Bachelor of Engineering with Honours (BE(Hons)) - 480 points First Year 2024 tuition fee estimate: $43,950 per 120 points 2025 tuition fee estimate: $45,665 per 120 points 2026 tuition fee estimate: $47,450 per 120 points; Second-Fourth Years 2024 $48,000 ...'; first-year figures recorded, as for the current record; the 2026 figure matches the existing 2026 row). Compulsory = Student Services Levy $9.17/point x 120 = $1,100.40 for both 2024 and 2025 (UC Calendar 2024/2025 Fees and Fines Regulations, as used for UC's other 2024/2025 rows). Corrects the earlier note that no earlier per-qualification estimates are available. laterYears added 2026-10-08 from the figures above; annualTuition is now the year-1 figure.

programmes.name: Master of Computer Science
programmes.summary: Programme fee paid at the start, spread over 1.5 years (the programme takes 12 to 18 months). Student services levy included; insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2027 Special Programme Fee $71,400 for the whole 180-point PMCS (paid at the start, 12-18 months), divided by 1.5 years. 2026 = $67,950 / 1.5; 2028 published as $75,000. Compulsory = 2026 Student Services Levy $10.30/point x 120 = $1,236 (2027 not yet published). SSL then $9.17/point x 120 = $1,100.40.
